methodology.summary: Median of 9 samples per operation/mode/variant; positive time_change_percent means slower after refactoring
methodology.scope: Existing bulk.php including input construction, target hydration for UoW UPDATE/DELETE, writes and transaction commit; each sample validates affected rows, SQL counts, managed state and database contents.

result.method: One outer transaction including commit per sample. Timed: input/entity construction, target hydration for UoW UPDATE/DELETE, DML and policy handling. Setup, context preloading and verification excluded. SQL counts include the two flush SAVEPOINT statements, but exclude driver begin/commit calls. One warm-up per case; case order rotates. Assigned IDs, no associations/callbacks/RETURNING/L2. PHP heap deltas, not RSS; retained references to preloaded entities stay alive for all modes. CLEAR empties the context on the first INSERT chunk. No Doctrine comparison or timing thresholds.
